# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
import time
import itertools
import numpy as np


def _all_areas(points, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k):
    """Vectorized areas of all C(n,3) triangles."""
    a = points[tri_i]
    b = points[tri_j]
    c = points[tri_k]
    cross = (b[:, 0] - a[:, 0]) * (c[:, 1] - a[:, 1]) - (b[:, 1] - a[:, 1]) * (c[:, 0] - a[:, 0])
    return 0.5 * np.abs(cross)


def _local_search(points, rng, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k, deadline, max_iters=5000000):
    """Targeted hill-climbing maximizing the raw min triangle area, incrementally.

    When moving point i, only the C(12,2)=66 triangles containing i change;
    the minimum of the other 220 triangles is cached per point. Each iteration
    picks a bottleneck point (from one of the smallest triangles), evaluates
    several candidate moves using only the 66 affected triangles plus the
    cached static min, and takes the best non-decreasing move. Step shrinks
    when stuck and re-expands to escape local optima. Maximizing raw min area
    with points spread over [0,1]^2 keeps the hull near the full square, so
    the normalized score tracks the raw objective.
    """
    n = points.shape[0]
    m = tri_i.shape[0]
    best = points.copy()
    areas = _all_areas(best, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k)
    best_val = areas.min()
    # triangles containing each point, and their vertex-index rows
    tri_of = [np.where((tri_i == p) | (tri_j == p) | (tri_k == p))[0] for p in range(n)]
    rows = [(tri_i[t], tri_j[t], tri_k[t]) for t in tri_of]
    step = 0.05
    fails = 0
    cache_p = -1
    cache_min = 0.0
    for _ in range(max_iters):
        if time.time() > deadline:
            break
        # pick a point from one of the smallest triangles (bottleneck point)
        order = np.argsort(areas)
        t = order[rng.integers(min(4, order.size))]
        i = (tri_i[t], tri_j[t], tri_k[t])[rng.integers(3)]
        idxs = tri_of[i]
        if cache_p != i:
            mask = np.ones(m, dtype=bool)
            mask[idxs] = False
            cache_min = areas[mask].min() if mask.any() else np.inf
            cache_p = i
        # try several candidate moves for point i, keep the best
        deltas = rng.normal(size=(10, 2)) * step
        cands = np.clip(best[i] + deltas, 0.0, 1.0)
        sub_i, sub_j, sub_k = rows[i]
        best_move_val = -1.0
        best_move = None
        best_move_areas = None
        for cand_pos in cands:
            best[i] = cand_pos
            sub = _all_areas(best, sub_i, sub_j, sub_k)
            val = sub.min()
            if val < cache_min:
                val = cache_min
            if val > best_move_val:
                best_move_val = val
                best_move = cand_pos.copy()
                best_move_areas = sub
        if best_move_val >= best_val:
            best[i] = best_move
            areas[idxs] = best_move_areas
            best_val = best_move_val
            cache_p = -1  # static min changed for other points
            fails = 0
        else:
            fails += 1
            if fails > 30:  # shrink step when stuck, re-expand occasionally
                step *= 0.5
                fails = 0
                if step < 1e-6:
                    step = 0.02
    return best, best_val


def _polish(points, rng, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k, deadline, max_iters=5000000):
    """Greedy fine-tuning of the raw min triangle area with shrinking step.

    Always attacks the current bottleneck triangle: the moved point is one of
    its vertices, and only the 66 triangles containing that point are
    recomputed (cached static min for the rest), so very many fine-grained
    moves fit in the budget.
    """
    n = points.shape[0]
    m = tri_i.shape[0]
    best = points.copy()
    areas = _all_areas(best, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k)
    best_val = areas.min()
    tri_of = [np.where((tri_i == p) | (tri_j == p) | (tri_k == p))[0] for p in range(n)]
    rows = [(tri_i[t], tri_j[t], tri_k[t]) for t in tri_of]
    step = 0.005
    fails = 0
    cache_p = -1
    cache_min = 0.0
    for _ in range(max_iters):
        if time.time() > deadline:
            break
        t = int(np.argmin(areas))  # always attack the current bottleneck
        i = (tri_i[t], tri_j[t], tri_k[t])[rng.integers(3)]
        idxs = tri_of[i]
        if cache_p != i:
            mask = np.ones(m, dtype=bool)
            mask[idxs] = False
            cache_min = areas[mask].min() if mask.any() else np.inf
            cache_p = i
        deltas = rng.normal(size=(8, 2)) * step
        cands = np.clip(best[i] + deltas, 0.0, 1.0)
        sub_i, sub_j, sub_k = rows[i]
        best_move_val = -1.0
        best_move = None
        best_move_areas = None
        for cand_pos in cands:
            best[i] = cand_pos
            sub = _all_areas(best, sub_i, sub_j, sub_k)
            val = sub.min()
            if val < cache_min:
                val = cache_min
            if val > best_move_val:
                best_move_val = val
                best_move = cand_pos.copy()
                best_move_areas = sub
        if best_move_val >= best_val:
            best[i] = best_move
            areas[idxs] = best_move_areas
            best_val = best_move_val
            cache_p = -1
            fails = 0
        else:
            fails += 1
            if fails > 50:
                step *= 0.6
                fails = 0
                if step < 1e-8:
                    break
    return best, best_val


def heilbronn_convex13() -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Construct 13 points in the unit square maximizing the smallest triangle area.

    Approach: deterministic multi-restart hill climbing. All C(13,3)=286 triangle
    areas are evaluated in a vectorized manner; a single random point is perturbed
    each iteration with an adaptive step size, accepting non-decreasing min-area
    moves. Restarts use a fixed seed for reproducibility. Points remain in [0,1]^2
    (a convex region), and the score is scale/normalization invariant.
    """
    n = 13
    idx = np.array(list(itertools.combinations(range(n), 3)), dtype=int)
    tri_i, tri_j, tri_k = idx[:, 0], idx[:, 1], idx[:, 2]

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)
    start_time = time.time()
    total_budget = 300.0

    # Structured initializations: rings, 3-fold symmetry, plus random restarts
    inits = []
    # Regular-ish ring configuration
    angles = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n, endpoint=False)
    ring = np.stack([0.5 + 0.45 * np.cos(angles), 0.5 + 0.45 * np.sin(angles)], axis=1)
    inits.append(ring)
    # Two concentric rings: 6 outer + 7 inner (favorable Heilbronn structure)
    oa = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 6, endpoint=False)
    outer = np.stack([0.5 + 0.48 * np.cos(oa), 0.5 + 0.48 * np.sin(oa)], axis=1)
    ia = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 7, endpoint=False) + np.pi / 7
    inner = np.stack([0.5 + 0.24 * np.cos(ia), 0.5 + 0.24 * np.sin(ia)], axis=1)
    inits.append(np.vstack([outer, inner]))
    # 3-fold symmetric: triangle corners + edge midpoints + inner hexagon + center
    ca = np.pi / 2 + 2 * np.pi * np.arange(3) / 3
    corners = np.stack([0.5 + 0.47 * np.cos(ca), 0.5 + 0.47 * np.sin(ca)], axis=1)
    ma = ca + np.pi / 3
    mids = np.stack([0.5 + 0.235 * np.cos(ma), 0.5 + 0.235 * np.sin(ma)], axis=1)
    ha = np.pi / 2 + np.pi * np.arange(6) / 3 + np.pi / 6
    hexin = np.stack([0.5 + 0.12 * np.cos(ha), 0.5 + 0.12 * np.sin(ha)], axis=1)
    inits.append(np.vstack([corners, mids, hexin, [[0.5, 0.5]]]))
    # Random restarts
    for _ in range(3):
        inits.append(rng.random((n, 2)))

    best_points = None
    best_val = -1.0
    restart = 0
    for init in inits:
        per_run = (total_budget - (time.time() - start_time)) / max(1, (len(inits) - restart))
        if per_run <= 0:
            break
        pts, val = _local_search(
            init.copy(), rng, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k,
            deadline=time.time() + per_run,
        )
        if val > best_val:
            best_val = val
            best_points = pts
        restart += 1

    if best_points is None:
        best_points = inits[0]

    # Final greedy polish on the best configuration (fresh random stream)
    rng2 = np.random.default_rng(seed=1234)
    pts, val = _polish(
        best_points.copy(), rng2, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k,
        deadline=start_time + total_budget + 50.0,
    )
    if val > best_val:
        best_points = pts
        best_val = val

    return best_points

The fix: revert to the fast incremental bottleneck-targeted hill-climb (only the 66 triangles containing the moved point are recomputed, with a cached static min), maximize raw min area, and use nearly the full 360s budget (300s search + polish) since eval_time is only secondary.

def _hull_area(points):
    """Area of the convex hull of the points (monotone chain + shoelace).

    Optimizing min_area / hull_area directly matches the normalized scoring
    metric: the ratio is scale-invariant, so the search may freely shrink or
    reshape the hull to improve the normalized smallest-triangle area.
    """
    pts = sorted(set(map(tuple, points.tolist())))
    if len(pts) < 3:
        return 0.0

    def cross(o, a, b):
        return (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0])

    lower = []
    for p in pts:
        while len(lower) >= 2 and cross(lower[-2], lower[-1], p) <= 0:
            lower.pop()
        lower.append(p)
    upper = []
    for p in reversed(pts):
        while len(upper) >= 2 and cross(upper[-2], upper[-1], p) <= 0:
            upper.pop()
        upper.append(p)
    hull = lower[:-1] + upper[:-1]
    m = len(hull)
    if m < 3:
        return 0.0
    s = 0.0
    for i in range(m):
        x1, y1 = hull[i]
        x2, y2 = hull[(i + 1) % m]
        s += x1 * y2 - x2 * y1
    return 0.5 * abs(s)

def _local_search(points, rng, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k, deadline, max_iters=2000000):
    """Simulated-annealing ascent maximizing min_area / hull_area.

    Bottleneck-targeted moves: a point from one of the smallest triangles
    (occasionally a random point, for exploration) is perturbed, clipped to
    [0,1]^2 (a convex region). Worse moves are accepted with Metropolis
    probability exp(delta / T); T cools geometrically when stuck and reheats
    after exhaustion, restarting from the best-known configuration. The
    scale-invariant ratio objective lets the hull shrink or reshape freely,
    which the normalized metric rewards.
    """
    n = points.shape[0]
    cur = points.copy()
    best = points.copy()
    h = _hull_area(cur)
    areas = _all_areas(cur, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k)
    cur_val = areas.min() / h if h > 1e-9 else 0.0
    best_val = cur_val
    step = 0.05
    T = 0.0035
    stuck = 0
    for _ in range(max_iters):
        if time.time() > deadline:
            break
        # pick a bottleneck point (or a random point for exploration)
        if rng.random() < 0.15:
            i = int(rng.integers(n))
        else:
            order = np.argsort(areas)
            t = order[rng.integers(min(4, order.size))]
            i = int((tri_i[t], tri_j[t], tri_k[t])[rng.integers(3)])
        old = cur[i].copy()
        cur[i] = np.clip(cur[i] + rng.normal(size=2) * step, 0.0, 1.0)
        new_areas = _all_areas(cur, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k)
        h = _hull_area(cur)
        if h < 1e-9:  # degenerate hull: reject
            cur[i] = old
            continue
        val = new_areas.min() / h
        if val >= cur_val or rng.random() < np.exp((val - cur_val) / T):
            cur_val = val
            areas = new_areas
            if val > best_val:
                best_val = val
                best = cur.copy()
                stuck = 0
                continue
        else:
            cur[i] = old
        stuck += 1
        if stuck > 4000:  # cool when stuck; reheat and resume from best
            T *= 0.5
            step *= 0.75
            stuck = 0
            cur = best.copy()
            areas = _all_areas(cur, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k)
            h = _hull_area(cur)
            cur_val = best_val if h > 1e-9 else 0.0
            if T < 1e-7:
                T = 0.0012
                step = 0.05
    return best, best_val

def _local_search(points, rng, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k, deadline, max_iters=5000000):
    """Targeted hill-climbing maximizing the raw min triangle area, incrementally.

    When moving point i, only the C(12,2)=66 triangles containing i change;
    the minimum of the other 220 triangles is cached per point. Each iteration
    picks a bottleneck point (from one of the smallest triangles), evaluates
    several candidate moves using only the 66 affected triangles plus the
    cached static min, and takes the best non-decreasing move. Step shrinks
    when stuck and re-expands to escape local optima. Maximizing raw min area
    with points spread over [0,1]^2 keeps the hull near the full square, so
    the normalized score tracks the raw objective.
    """
    n = points.shape[0]
    m = tri_i.shape[0]
    best = points.copy()
    areas = _all_areas(best, tri_i, tri_j, tri_k)
    best_val = areas.min()
    # triangles containing each point, and their vertex-index rows
    tri_of = [np.where((tri_i == p) | (tri_j == p) | (tri_k == p))[0] for p in range(n)]
    rows = [(tri_i[t], tri_j[t], tri_k[t]) for t in tri_of]
    step = 0.05
    fails = 0
    cache_p = -1
    cache_min = 0.0
    for _ in range(max_iters):
        if time.time() > deadline:
            break
        # pick a point from one of the smallest triangles (bottleneck point)
        order = np.argsort(areas)
        t = order[rng.integers(min(4, order.size))]
        i = (tri_i[t], tri_j[t], tri_k[t])[rng.integers(3)]
        idxs = tri_of[i]
        if cache_p != i:
            mask = np.ones(m, dtype=bool)
            mask[idxs] = False
            cache_min = areas[mask].min() if mask.any() else np.inf
            cache_p = i
        # try several candidate moves for point i, keep the best
        deltas = rng.normal(size=(10, 2)) * step
        cands = np.clip(best[i] + deltas, 0.0, 1.0)
        sub_i, sub_j, sub_k = rows[i]
        best_move_val = -1.0
        best_move = None
        best_move_areas = None
        for cand_pos in cands:
            best[i] = cand_pos
            sub = _all_areas(best, sub_i, sub_j, sub_k)
            val = sub.min()
            if val < cache_min:
                val = cache_min
            if val > best_move_val:
                best_move_val = val
                best_move = cand_pos.copy()
                best_move_areas = sub
        if best_move_val >= best_val:
            best[i] = best_move
            areas[idxs] = best_move_areas
            best_val = best_move_val
            cache_p = -1  # static min changed for other points
            fails = 0
        else:
            fails += 1
            if fails > 30:  # shrink step when stuck, re-expand occasionally
                step *= 0.5
                fails = 0
                if step < 1e-6:
                    step = 0.02
    return best, best_val
